title: Privacy Policy
content:
This Privacy Policy explains how Baran Ahmedov processes personal data when you visit or use Baran's Scoreboard at [https://scoreboard.baranhq.com/](https://scoreboard.baranhq.com/) (the Website).

## 1. Controller and scope

The data controller is Baran Ahmedov, an individual based in Bulgaria. You can contact me at [baran@baranhq.com](mailto:baran@baranhq.com).

The Website does not require a public account, name, or email address. Technical information is processed when your browser requests a page. Optional analytics are separate and can be refused.

## 2. Information used to provide and protect the Website

The network delivery and security service and the shared hosting provider receive connection and request information. Depending on the request and configuration, this may include your IP address, requested page or resource, date and time, browser and device headers, referrer, and network or security signals. The hosting account has AWStats enabled; it generates traffic reports from hosting access logs. These provider-side processes are separate from the Website's optional analytics and continue if you reject them.

To limit abuse of the privacy API and private administrator sign-in, the application uses the connection IP address to calculate a purpose-specific keyed hash and a short-lived request counter. The application table stores the hash and counter, not the raw IP address. The counter has a 15-minute expiry; the maintenance process removes expired entries, but its schedule has not been confirmed. The network delivery and security service receives your connection IP address. The hosting provider receives a forwarded request; the IP address, if any, shown in its access logs depends on the server configuration.

These activities support delivery, operation, troubleshooting, security, and abuse prevention. I rely on my legitimate interests in operating and protecting the Website (Article 6(1)(f) of the [General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng)). If you email me, I process your email address, message, attachments, and related correspondence details to answer you and handle related legal claims, on the basis of my legitimate interests in managing enquiries and protecting legal rights. The public Website has no visitor sign-in. The private administration area is restricted to the operator and uses an administrator session.

## 3. Optional analytics

The Privacy choices panel offers separate choices for Site usage analytics and an external page-analytics service. Both are off until you select and save them. You can reject both and continue to use the Website; closing the panel is not consent. The legal basis for either optional analytics service is your consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR).

If you allow Site usage analytics, the application records a random browser preference token as a hash, visit and page-view times, a limited public page path, and estimated active time. Recent keyboard, pointer, and scroll activity is used only to estimate active time while the page is visible and focused; individual interactions are not stored as analytics events. The analytics database does not intentionally store your IP address, query strings, form contents, or scoreboard data. Authenticated administrator visits are excluded.

If you allow the external page-analytics service, the browser downloads its beacon and sends page-view, page-path, referrer, and performance information. Its reports may include browser, device, operating-system, and approximate country categories. The ordinary beacon request includes your IP address. The provider says it discards that address at the nearest network location and does not store it in its core analytics databases or logs; it also says the beacon does not access browser cookies or storage. The application does not send scoreboard contents or form entries to this beacon. The application-managed beacon is loaded only after its separate saved choice. Infrastructure processing needed to deliver and secure the Website is not controlled by this choice.

Withdrawing Site usage analytics stops future collection and deletes the live visit records linked to your preference token. Withdrawing page analytics stops new beacon loading after the page reloads; a request already in progress may finish. Withdrawal does not automatically remove data already held by the page-analytics provider, hosting logs, security systems, AWStats reports, or backups.

## 4. Scoreboards and browser storage

Scoreboards and their names, scores, icons, timer state, and appearance settings are stored in your browser's IndexedDB. Saved leaderboards and brackets are kept in a separate IndexedDB database only after you choose Save. Unsaved edits may be held temporarily in sessionStorage as a recovery draft. Images and JSON backups are generated locally. The application does not intentionally upload this content to its server or include it in either analytics service.

Local storage may keep your selected scoreboard, language, theme, custom tool themes, language-suggestion choice, and the date an optional project-support reminder was last shown. The Website reads your preferred browser languages and, when you choose the system theme, your device's light/dark setting locally. These values are not sent as separate data fields, although ordinary requests may include browser headers such as Accept-Language.

A share link contains a scoreboard snapshot in the URL fragment (the part after #), not in the ordinary request sent to the Website. The application removes an incoming share fragment before its consent-controlled beacon can load. Anyone with the full link can view and copy that snapshot. Saved browser data remains until you delete it or your browser removes site data; session recovery drafts normally end with the tab. You can export a backup to your device or delete saved tables in the Website.

## 5. Cookies and privacy choices

The Website sets a score_preferences cookie when you save a privacy choice, including a rejection. It contains a random opaque token used to retrieve your choices; the server stores the token as a hash. The cookie lasts up to 180 days and, on HTTPS, is Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Lax. The corresponding server-side choice expires after 180 days.

The private administrator area uses a separate score_admin session cookie. It is not a visitor login and the administrator session expires after no more than one hour. On HTTPS, the cookie is Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Strict.

The network security service may set a security cookie if a particular protection or challenge requires it. Its presence and lifetime depend on the feature in use.

## 6. Service providers and international processing

To run the Website, information may be handled by categories of service providers: shared hosting, database and backup services; network delivery and security services; the external page-analytics service, if you allow it; and the email service if you contact me. Their personnel may access information as needed to operate or support those services. Information may also be disclosed where required by law or to establish, exercise, or defend legal claims. The Website does not sell personal data or use advertising tracking.

The network service operates across multiple locations, and some providers may process information outside Bulgaria or the European Economic Area (EEA). The specific locations and transfer safeguards applicable to each service in this account have not been confirmed. Contact me for the information available about a particular processing activity.

If you follow an external link, the destination site handles your visit under its own privacy information.

## 7. Retention

Site usage analytics older than 365 days are excluded from administration reports. The maintenance process deletes older analytics records when it runs; its schedule has not been confirmed, so physical deletion may occur later. Older interaction-event records collected by earlier versions are no longer collected or shown in current reports and are deleted by the same cleanup process.

The privacy-choice cookie lasts up to 180 days. Its server record expires after 180 days and is removed by maintenance after 365 days from the last update; expired records may remain until cleanup runs. Request-rate counters expire after 15 minutes and are removed when maintenance runs; the maintenance schedule has not been confirmed. Administrator sessions last no more than one hour.

The hosting account is configured for weekly incremental backups. Four recovery points were present when this policy was updated; the exact retention and expiry period has not been confirmed. Data removed from active systems may remain in a recovery point until that copy expires or is replaced. Hosting access-log and AWStats retention, and network-security log retention, are set by the relevant providers and have not been confirmed for this account.

For the external page-analytics service, its published documentation says unsampled beacon data is kept for seven days, after which about 10% is aggregated for longer-term storage; dashboard history is available for up to six months. The provider controls this retention and may change it.

I keep email messages while they are needed to answer an enquiry or handle related legal obligations or claims. Mailbox copies and any provider backups follow the email account's settings, which have not been confirmed. Browser-stored content remains under your control as described above.

## 8. Your rights and children

Depending on the circumstances, you may have rights to access, correct, erase, or restrict your personal data; request portability where applicable; object to processing based on legitimate interests; and withdraw consent at any time. Withdrawal does not affect processing carried out before it. These rights are subject to the conditions and exceptions in law. Email me to make a request; I may ask for information reasonably necessary to identify the relevant records and protect them from disclosure to someone else.

You may complain to the Bulgarian [Commission for Personal Data Protection](https://cpdp.bg/en/) or another competent data-protection authority.

The Website does not ask for a visitor's age or create student accounts. Under Article 25c of Bulgaria's [Personal Data Protection Act](https://cpdp.bg/en/legislation/personal-data-protection-act/), consent for processing personal data of a child under 14 must be given by a parent exercising parental rights or by the child's guardian. This Website has no age or guardian-verification step; a child under 14 should not enable optional analytics without that permission. This notice does not obtain parental consent. The Website does not make decisions about visitors based solely on automated processing that produce legal or similarly significant effects.

## 9. Contact and changes

For privacy questions or requests, contact:

**Baran Ahmedov, Bulgaria**

[baran@baranhq.com](mailto:baran@baranhq.com)

This Policy may be updated when the Website or its data practices change. The date shown on this page identifies the current version.
